condition: recombinant preassembled WT shell loaded in vitro with native Fdx cargo
notes: Native Fdx cargo-loaded WT QtEnc state generated by post-assembly in vitro loading. Cryo-EM at 2.47 Å showed intact properly assembled shells and directly resolved the interaction between the Fdx N-terminal cargo-loading peptide and internal shell binding sites. PDB 11YX / EMD-76203. Fdx is the native minor 2Fe-2S ferredoxin cargo encoded in the QtEnc operon; this structure represents the first visualization of an N-terminal CLP-shell interaction.
